faq.q: What photo should I upload for skincare?
faq.a: Upload a clear photo with the full package and readable label. Soft light helps prevent glare on glossy tubes and glass.

faq.q: Does the beauty clip include a voice and captions?
faq.a: Yes. Add a spoken message and captions to your beauty ad. You can change both before you download and post it.

faq.q: Can one product photo become a beauty ad?
faq.a: Yes. Upload a beauty product photo or paste its link to make a short ad. Try a routine, unboxing, or product demo without arranging a shoot.

faq.q: Will the ad show my foundation or lipstick shade accurately?
faq.a: It can follow the color in your photo, but check every finished ad against the real shade. A clear photo in natural light helps keep the color accurate.

faq.q: Can I show a before-and-after with my beauty product?
faq.a: Yes. Show the product going on and the finished look in one short ad. Keep the result true to what customers can expect.

faq.q: Can I put a price or a promo code on the image?
faq.a: Yes. Add your real price, code, and shade name to the ad. Review the words before posting so the offer matches your shop.

faq.q: How is this different from hiring a creator?
faq.a: You can make a beauty ad from a photo or link without paying a creator or arranging a shoot. Try several openings quickly to see what fits your audience.

faq.q: Can I run the clips as paid beauty ads?
faq.a: Yes. Finished beauty ads have no watermark and can be used commercially. Keep product claims and prices accurate before publishing.

faq.q: How long can a beauty ad be, and what does it cost?
faq.a: Choose 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds for 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits. One image costs 24 credits. Starter costs $24.50 monthly for 200 credits, Pro $35 for 300, and Premium $63 for 600.
